rules.sentence: Consequently, it is advised to close the defect in patients exhibiting a significant left-to-right shunt (Qp:Qs>2:1).

Indications for opting for transcatheter VSD closure include cardiomegaly or left heart enlargement as seen on an echocardiogram, a Qp:Qs ratio exceeding 1.5, failure to thrive, worsening symptoms according to the New York Heart Association classification, recurrent respiratory infections, and a history of infective endocarditis.
